New links starting in “To read” feels right, and moving them to “Done” is clear. Delete also makes sense as a permanent removal, distinct from the reversible Archive action.

I wouldn’t treat Archived as a third reading status in a straight sequence, though. Archiving should simply hide a bookmark from the normal lists while remembering whether it was “To read” or “Done.” When I restore it, I’d expect it to return to the state it had before, rather than always moving to “To read.” Archived links should otherwise appear only in the Archived view.
